attchmntText: Celebrity Fashions Limited has informed the Exchange about Copy of Newspaper Publication - financial results
voiceSummary: Celebrity Fashions Limited published a newspaper advertisement on 14th November 2026 regarding its un-audited financial results for the quarter and half year ended 30th September 2026. The advertisement appeared in Business Standards and Tamil Murasu. The company approved these results at a Board Meeting held on 13th November 2026. The announcement includes financial data in lakhs of rupees. Total income from operations was 1,911.08 for the quarter and 3,829.83 for the half year. Net profit after tax was 226.27 for the quarter and 408.47 for the half year. Earnings per share were 0.17 for the quarter and 0.30 for the half year. Paid up equity share capital remained at 1,341.24 lakhs. The full results are available on the company website and stock exchange portals.

attchmntText: Celebrity Fashions Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Celebrity Fashions Limited approved the Unaudited Financial Results for the quarter and half year ended 30th September 2026. The Board meeting was held on 13th November 2026. The company reported a loss after tax of 0.80 crores for the quarter and 3.17 crores for the half year. Revenue from operations was 26.59 crores for the quarter and 53.01 crores for the half year. Accumulated losses stand at 58.10 crores as of 30th September 2026. The auditor issued a clean review report but noted a material uncertainty related to going concern due to these accumulated losses. The financial statements were prepared on a going concern basis. Basic and diluted earnings per share were negative 0.12 rupees for the quarter and negative 0.49 rupees for the half year. The results are subject to standard regulatory disclosures.
